mappings.qualification: Complete own-state 0x650e40 audio name lookup over a prepared readable 1,600-row table at global 0x2947b74, stride 64, name pointer at row+0. Every row, including indices 0 and 1599 and rows with no other initialization, is eligible. First bounded case-folded match wins; null name pointers are skipped by comparison, null query never matches, and missing query returns 0xffffffff after original RET-only diagnostic 0x64fdb0. Raw comparison preserves null precedence, lengths 0/-1/-2/other negatives, terminator behavior, signed-byte ordering, ASCII lowercase and e0..ff folding. Query/catalog names require readable backing for all accesses; PAR calls provide exact 16-byte arrays with length 16, including nonterminated full16-byte queries. Negative/dynamic length fixtures provide terminated names. 976 direct native cases include 631 particle and 345 audio cases, with unchanged original comparators/lookup bodies. Existing 0x658330/0x658490 mappings receive no duplicate credit: a new PAR byte-array adapter projects actual three-pass/general vs two-pass/fast loaded registry behavior, reserved index 0, exclusion, low-byte preferred bank, active group 0/1 fallback and signed group-byte third pass, including prepared signed flag backing outside nominal eight groups. Particle query names must be terminated inside the provided array; all authored particle requests satisfy this. Composed 224 cases run all 112 unchanged authored PAR files through both general/group2 and fast/preferred-group5 prepared catalogs, along with phase14 loaded sprites and phase13 recovered activation/selection. Original native loader/record/sprite/particle/audio/comparison/runtime bodies execute; only local file transport is adapted. Full 843,784-byte image, asset argument SHA/counts, runtime/transport traces, transport state and EAX are retained. Model images matching native hashes contain 12,228 resolved particle references, 9,784 audio references and 3,726 sprite slots. Catalogs are prepared from exact input binding requests, not recovered original assets or producers. Existing phase13 finite/x87 projection limits remain. Renderer, audio playback and particle emission are not implemented. Source and both portable harnesses compile as library; managed fixture execution is pending, with no generated executable launch.
